751-4289-7730.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Vein Ripper and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3099-3995-4474.easyPrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle is attached to Horseshoe Crab.
3099-3995-4474.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3995-4474.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

728-1981-2415-3330.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-3330.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1409-1780-7824.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

261-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-3122.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-3122.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-3122.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

620-2060-2762-6751.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Yotian Dissident triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4359-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4359-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4509-7296.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-7296.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

3291-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 7.
3291-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Karametra's Acolyte.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

891-997-2843.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

573-1558-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2308-4050-4268-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4268-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Kor Celebrant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7157.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4359-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1976-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1850-4426-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-5413.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2999-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5330-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5330-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1445-2279-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-2279-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-3769-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2438-3769-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

225-774-3478.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

282-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-4779-5365.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.
282-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

81-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
81-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3244-3858-5171.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of permanent cards in your library equal to or greater than nineteen minus The Mycotyrant's power.
3244-3858-5171.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library, causing you to descend once for each permanent card put into your graveyard this way.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mycotyrant triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus creature tokens equal to the number of times you've descended this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

2178-4319-4424-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Skirk Alarmist.
2178-4319-4424-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability and Skirk Alarmist trigger.
Resolve the Missy ability, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Skirk Alarmist trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

372-2719-3908.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-3908.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

855-2060-2122-4279.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Crystalline Crawler and Mindless Automaton have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
855-2060-2122-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding a card, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and Mindless Automaton.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-2374-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1124-2034-2793-4450-5089.manaNeeded: {2} on your first turn, with {7} available on all subsequent turns
1124-2034-2793-4450-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by exiling Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you to activate all planeswalker abilities an extra time this turn.
 Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

151-349-618-908.notablePrerequisites: Norritt does not have summoning sickness.
151-349-618-908.description:
Cast Cerulean Wisps for {U} targeting Kiki-Jiki, making Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite tapped tokens with haste.
Cast To Arms! to untap your tapped tokens.

813-1964-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
813-1964-1987-3075.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
